hooks.name: Purity ban check on save

action.command: grep -rnE 'Math\.random|Date\.now|performance\.now' packages/*/src apps/studio/src --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' | grep -vE 'apps/studio/src/playback/' || echo 'No banned wall-clock/random calls outside the studio playback clock.'

hooks.description: On save of any .ts/.tsx under a package or app src, reports any Math.random/Date.now/performance.now outside apps/studio/src/playback/ (the only place the studio spec allows the playback clock). Report only, edits nothing.
